decision_reason: The integrated assessment addresses the requested infrastructure, UI/UX, security, flow, content, prototype and Git-estate scope with distinct evidence boundaries. The plan turns findings into bounded, ordered, reviewable packages and realistic acceptance evidence. Three nonblocking wording/path/dependency corrections would improve handoff precision. Approval concerns the recommendation packet only, not implementation or publication.

evidence.observation: Coverage is explicit for source, all released HTML routes, English editorial inventory, locales, browser matrix, focused tasks, Git refs/PRs and external basis; exhaustive security/native assistive technology/external product internals are not falsely claimed.

limits: This reviewer shares the parent model, conversation history and task context. The review is an independent outcome role pass, not statistically independent validation.

This reviewer authored the earlier content/estate workstream. This pass judged only the parent-authored integrated assessment and advancement plan; it did not grade or revise its own workstream report.

No new full browser, security, accessibility, performance or external-application suite was run. Source and evidence claims outside the editorial workstream were assessed for traceability, scope and decision usefulness rather than independently reproduced.
The frozen files are draft-1. Any later edits change artifact hashes and require adjudication plus proportional re-review of changed claims.
Approval does not certify website security, accessibility compliance, native-language quality, business value, implementation readiness of unknown external systems, or publication authorization.
